items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Pat Metheny Quintet with Dewey Redman, Michael Brecker, Metheny, Charlie Haden and yourself... Pat and I had been playing together.

ctx.x: I know he played drums, too. I know Chick plays drums, too.
He plays drums too. And actually Pat Metheny was a trumpet player.

items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s yourself, Herbie Hancock, Pat Matheny... We toured that band worldwide

ctx.x: Yeah, that was a great record. Real Time.
A lot of projects with so many folks. Here’s one that I was not aware of called Parallel Realities. It’s yourself, Herbie Hancock, Pat Matheny. It’s released on MCA, it’s under your name.
Yeah that was a big record! We toured that band worldwide when we added Dave Holland.
